messages.text: Back-tested the 20% / 4-week rule on West Q2. It would have flagged 61 of the 74 HCPs that later switched, median 3 weeks earlier than the QBR. False positive rate about 18%.
3 weeks earlier is huge. Can we get the false positives down?
Requiring 2 consecutive weeks below threshold drops FP to ~9% but we lose 1 week of lead time. Trade-off for product to decide.
Template approval process: medical-legal review takes 10 working days per template version. Plan for that before launch. Also alerts must be retained for 2 years for audit.
Field ops view: please no SMS. Reps use personal phones for SMS and we can't send HCP names there. In-app + email only.
+1 to Meera. HCP names over SMS to personal devices is a no from compliance.
For top-decile HCPs I still want something faster than weekly. Can we at least do a mid-week push for decile 10 only?
Data lands Tuesday, so a Wednesday push for decile 10 is technically possible. Monday digest for everyone else.
Re competitor attribution: we only have market-level share, not which brand each HCP switched to. Not reliable at HCP level.
Rep interviews summary is in the doc. Big themes: weekly planning rhythm, explain-the-why, snooze/dismiss with reason, offline iPad.
